chapter: Hampton, Andy Kirk and Charlie Barnet
title: Minton's and meeting Dizzy
summary: He first goes to Minton's with Dizzy in 1941, sits in, and recalls first hearing Dizzy with Cab Calloway without being impressed.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Now, in that period in New York, did you start going up and playing at Minton's and Monroe's and like that?
Yeah. Well, I started going up to Minton's when I came here with Andy Kirk. We played at the Loews Theatre down on...
'41. That's when I met Dizzy, and he took me up to Minton's. I used to go up there and play, sit in with them and play. But I really didn't start hanging out
up there at Minton's until Georgie Auld, after I went with Georgie Auld. But that's sometime a little later on, when I started going to Minton's. But I used to go up there with Dizzy, you know.
Now, here you had been listening to Roy and kind of in that style...
Well, I heard Dizzy, but I didn't think nothin' about him, because he came in a show with Cab, and I didn't think nothin' about his playing.
Well, he wasn't that different then, really

Yeah, I guess he was, because I didn't hear no difference in what he was doing than from anybody else. Until when I got here to New York, and that was much later when I got to know him, when he was playing with Billy Eckstine and shit.
